children: Overview
Sweden commercial property owner's Q3 rental income rose 12% yr/yr
Q3 profit from property management grew 12% yr/yr, driven by higher net operating income
Net profit after tax for Q3 increased 52% yr/yr
Outlook
NP3 maintains 2026 profit from property management forecast at SEK 1,240 mln
Company expects stable demand but notes longer decision-making due to interest rate volatility
NP3 sees good prospects to strengthen occupancy rate and cash flow as economy recovers
Result Drivers
HIGHER RENTAL INCOME - Co said Q3 net operating income rose mainly due to higher rental income from a larger property portfolio
LOWER INTEREST RATE - CEO said profit from property management rose due to higher net operating income and a lower average interest rate
ACQUISITIONS IMPACT - Co said vacancy value increased slightly, mainly due to vacancies in acquired properties
